Welcome to Veterinary Anatomy, a dedicated educational channel created to bring the fascinating world of animal anatomy to life!

Here, you’ll explore clear, high-quality dissection videos and systematic overviews of the major body systems — skeletal, muscular, nervous, and internal organs — presented with precision and clarity. Each video is designed to help you see, understand, and remember anatomical structures as they appear in real dissections.

We highlight the similarities and differences among the most important domestic animals, including the horse, ox, camel, sheep, goat, dog, and cat. You’ll also find insights from rare and exotic species as we expand our content.

Whether you’re a veterinary or animal science student, a researcher, or simply an animal enthusiast, this channel offers valuable resources to deepen your understanding of the animal body and its incredible adaptations.

Dr. Aiyan, BVM, MSc, PhD
Associate Professor of Veterinary Anatomy
